workflow.merge_rule: Codex may merge non-production work only after every gate in AGENTS.md passes

tasks.title: Foundation and executable contract
scope: Scaffold the TypeScript modular monolith
Add typed environment validation and a secret-free .env.example
Add health endpoint, structured errors, trace IDs, test harness, lint, typecheck, and build scripts
Document local startup and test commands
acceptance_criteria: A clean checkout installs and starts from documented commands
GET /api/v1/health returns a typed healthy response without sensitive data
Lint, typecheck, unit tests, and production build pass
No credentials or production deployment are introduced

tasks.title: Tenant identity, schema, and RLS proof
scope: Create organizations, memberships, learners, learning events, learner state, memory, decision, usage, budget, and audit migrations
Enable and force RLS on every tenant-owned table
Implement trusted organization resolution and role checks
Create organization-versus-organization and individual-workspace isolation tests
acceptance_criteria: Normal request paths do not use a service-role bypass
Organization A cannot perform any CRUD operation on organization B rows
Suspended membership loses access
Individual workspaces cannot create or read organization-shared memory
Migration and isolation tests pass from a clean database

tasks.title: Learning-event and mastery loop
scope: Implement idempotent POST /api/v1/events
Implement deterministic evidence weighting, mastery bands, confidence, and misconception rules
Store algorithm version and evidence trail
Add outcome recording
acceptance_criteria: Duplicate external event IDs do not double-apply evidence
Learner state updates are deterministic and tenant-isolated
Rule behavior has boundary and regression tests
Sensitive raw payloads are absent from logs

tasks.title: Governed memory and cost controls
scope: Implement private learner memory
Implement organization memory candidate, approval, versioning, expiry, and retrieval
Add deterministic fingerprints, duplicate prevention, cache metadata, budgets, usage ledger, timeouts, retries, and circuit breaker
Prove an approved-memory hit skips model generation
acceptance_criteria: Only approved active memory is retrievable inside its organization
Shared memory contains no direct learner identifier or raw chat
Individual workspaces remain private-only
Budget exhaustion blocks provider calls safely
Memory hit, cache, and circuit-breaker paths are covered by tests

tasks.title: Adaptive decision and grounded tutor
scope: Implement POST /api/v1/adapt and POST /api/v1/tutor
Add provider-neutral Meta Llama adapter and small-versus-strong route policy
Validate structured model output and add deterministic fallback
Add age-aware policy and curriculum grounding boundary
acceptance_criteria: Responses include trace, source, reason codes, and review recommendation
Model failure falls back without breaking the partner product
Organization, budget, memory, and safety decisions cannot be overridden by model output
Provider calls and estimated costs are auditable without storing child personal data

tasks.title: Pilot console, SDK, and integration proof
scope: Add a minimal educator console for learner state, memory approval, budget, and traces
Add a typed TypeScript client
Create one mock partner integration proving ALIA is optional and independently deployable
Add an end-to-end golden path
acceptance_criteria: Educator permissions are enforced server-side
An approved memory candidate can be reviewed and then reused
The client handles typed unavailable and budget responses
The mock partner continues with a deterministic local fallback when ALIA is unavailable

tasks.title: Staging hardening and pilot evidence
scope: Run security, RLS, deletion, rate-limit, budget, recovery, and smoke tests
Add staging runbook, incident rollback, known limitations, and privacy checklist
Prepare a controlled demo data set and evidence report
Deploy only to staging after explicit approval and valid credentials
acceptance_criteria: CI is green and no critical or high known issue remains
RLS denial, memory isolation, fallback, and budget evidence is recorded
Rollback and known limitations are documented
Marketing language says founding-pilot alpha and makes no unsupported impact claim
